## Engine capability backlog

| Capability | Status | Kind | Cards | Spec |
|---|---|---|--:|---|
| `activate-from-zone` | implemented | ability | 2 | Allow an activated ability to declare an activation zone (discard / hand / void) and be usable from there (RECUR / EXHUMATION / RETIRE). The sourceInZone condition already exists; the activation path (getActivatableAbilities, cost payment, source lookup) assumes zone==='play'. Prestige Inversion, Spatchcocking; pervasive later. |
| `bind-variable` | implemented | effect | 1 | Effect { type:'bind', id, value:NumberExpression } evaluates `value` immediately and stores it in ResolutionContext.variables[id] for later effects in the same ability — so a value captured from a card (its strength/life) survives that card leaving play mid-effect. Merbegon; Pony Slaystation could use it but doesn't need it. |
| `combat-restrictions` | implemented | ids, battle | 1 | Extend Restriction with 'mustAttack' / 'mustBlock' (forced combat) and enforce in declareAttack/declareBlockers legality + a UI hint. 94r913 My 908570pp3r5. |
| `continuous-aura` | implemented | ability | 2 | A ContinuousAbility whose modifiers/keywords/restrictions apply to EVERY card matching a CardSelector (recomputed live), not a single TargetRef. Per-target values may derive from the target ('lose life equal to printed life minus 2'). Needed for team buffs/debuffs that aren't one-shot tactics. |
| `cost-modifier` | implemented | ability | 3 | Continuous 'a given player (self/opponents/all) must pay +N / pays -N (min M) to deploy cards matching <selector or named subtype>'. Feeds getCardPlayability/playCard cost math. Vilghame, Ensmallment Ray, Port Manteau; very common. |
| `count-resource-icons` | implemented | expression | 3 | NumberExpression { type:'resourceIcons', player, icon } = how many of a given resource icon a player controls in play (face-up resource icons + Volition for face-down). Also serves 'while you control at least [X][X]' threshold-style gates via numberCompare. High-frequency across every Seed-era set. |
| `damage-modifier` | implemented | ability, battle | 1 | Static/continuous 'when battle (or any) damage is inflicted to <selector>, increase/decrease the amount by N', applied during damage assignment. Distinct from replacement-effect (adjusts an amount, doesn't cancel). Shieldmane Grandchest; common in Seed 2. |
| `damage-self-cost` | implemented | cost | 1 | Cost { type:'dealDamage', target, amount } — pay by inflicting damage on a card you control (typically 'source'), used by locations that spend their own structure. Intriguing Mezzanine ('Inflict 1 damage to this location. If you do, ...'). |
| `deck-position-ref` | implemented | expression, effect | 3 | Reference the top / bottom N cards of a deck: a TargetRef/selector form ({ type:'deckPosition', player, from:'top'|'bottom', count }) and a `position` option on moveCard's destination when to==='deck'. Axeclaw (cost of top card), Stone of Triumph (put on top), Geiseric / Cowslaw digging. |
| `deploy-history` | implemented | state, condition | 1 | Per-turn record of what each player deployed (by name) so a condition can ask 'did an opponent deploy >=2 cards with the same name this turn'. Refrigerator Alarm. |
| `flip-up` | implemented | cost, context | 5 | Alternate deploy path: a card may be played face-down as a resource now and later 'flipped up' by paying its FLIP UP cost (icons + sometimes an influence loss / bonus action). Needs (a) a play mode that pays an alternate Cost[] parsed from a 'FLIP UP: ...' clause, (b) a resolution-context flag deployedViaFlipUp readable by conditions/variables, (c) a face-down permanent that remembers its flip-up cost. Pervasive from Seed 2 on. |
| `for-each-player` | implemented | effect | 2 | Effect { type:'forEachPlayer', order, effects } running sub-effects once per player with `controller`/`owner` rebound to that player (turn order). Community Chest, Spatchcocking. |
| `grant-ability-text` | implemented | ability | 1 | A continuous effect that grants ability/keyword/Unique DATA (not printed English) to every card matching a selector, with values keyed off each card ('gains Unique X where X is its name'). God's Autograph. Rare, large; likely deferred past the pilot. |
| `has-unique-condition` | implemented | condition | 1 | Condition / CardSelector predicate 'card has a Unique designation' (unique != null). Trivial once `unique` metadata is populated. Prestige Inversion. |
| `meta-use-ability` | implemented | effect | 1 | Effect that lets the controller activate one of a TARGET card's abilities as a sub-resolution, optionally doubling its effect. Notion Sickness. Rare, large; likely deferred past the pilot. |
| `mill` | implemented | effect | 1 | Effect { type:'mill', player, count } = move the top `count` cards of a deck to its owner's discard. Ipsighast, Overzealous Excavation (Seed 2), many. |
| `name-a-value` | implemented | choice, expression | 1 | PendingChoice 'nameValue' (player names a card name or a subtype from a closed list) + a variable binding a string, referenced by conditions/cost-modifier selectors. Mirrors chooserSelectsOption's structured+label shape. Port Manteau. |
| `name-match-condition` | implemented | condition | 1 | Condition comparing one card name to another (e.g. a deck card whose name equals the triggering event card) — "search your deck for a card with the same name". The Stone of Triumph. |
| `nth-this-turn` | implemented | condition, state | 1 | Per-turn counter so a trigger can fire only on the Nth matching event this turn ('the first resource each opponent plays each turn'). Needs a small serializable per-turn tally + an eventOrdinal condition. Vilghame Manewaft. |
| `optional-cost-in-effect` | implemented | effect | 1 | "You may pay N. If you do, ..." as a step inside a triggered/replacement effect list — a payResources-carrying chooser branch or a dedicated payCost effect. The Stone of Triumph, and shared with replacement-effect-optional. |
| `play-extra-cost-nontactic` | implemented | engine | 1 | Honor a designated on-play ability's targets/costs/condition (the tactic 'first activated ability' convention in getPlayTargetDeclarations/getTacticCosts) for NON-tactic permanents too, so a character/item/location can carry 'EXTRA COST: pick 2 characters' + an ETB that uses them. Intriguing Mezzanine. |
| `printed-stat` | implemented | expression | 1 | NumberExpression { type:'printedStat', target, stat } = a card's printed BASE stat before modifiers (parallel to cardCost). Fornicaves ('printed life minus 2'). |
| `replacement-effect` | implemented | ability-kind | 4 | A 'if X would happen, instead Y' layer consulted BEFORE a mutation commits. New ability kind 'replacement' with an event-shaped match, an optional 'you may + cost' gate, and replacement effects. Deepest addition; several Seed 3 Uniques plus many later cards. [IMPLEMENTED: mandatory + optional forms, events moveToZone / destroy. replaces.controlledBy scopes on whose card is affected; replaces.by ('self'|'opponent'|'any') scopes on who initiated it ('by an opposing card or effect') incl. lethal battle damage. Damage-would-be-inflicted is not a replaceable event (no card needs it; damageModifiers cover amount tuning).] |
| `replacement-effect-optional` | implemented | ability-kind, choice | 2 | The optional/gated form of a replacement ability: "if X would happen, you MAY pay <cost> (and/or choose). If you do, <Y> instead; otherwise X happens." Needs a pause (PendingChoice) mid-replacement. Giada, Geiseric. |
| `responding-to-condition` | implemented | condition | 1 | Play-timing condition 'this is being deployed in response to a <cardType> being deployed' (inspects the response window's triggering stack item) + a TargetRef for that item so its cost can be referenced. Anatidaephobia. |
| `restore-restriction` | implemented | state | 1 | Tag on a card instance ('not restored by its controller's faction restore rule'), set by an effect/cost and consulted in applyFactionStartOfTurn. Intriguing Mezzanine. |
| `sacrifice-selected-cost` | implemented | cost | 1 | Generalize depleteSelected into a cost that consumes already-selected cards by a given disposition (removeFromGame / destroy / moveCard) — 'remove X tactics in your discard pile from the game' as a cost. Cowslaw. |
| `terminate-stack-item` | implemented | effect | 3 | Effect { type:'terminate', target } that removes a still-unresolved card/ability from the response stack (a.k.a. 'counter'), sending a terminated card to its owner's discard without resolving. Also an 'all other unresolved cards' form. Great Wall, Anatidaephobia, Refrigerator Alarm. |
| `token-permanents` | implemented | effect | 2 | Create N token permanents in play not backed by a deck card (named 'Micromajig' etc., with printed stats / a definition supplied inline or by a synthetic CardDefinition). Cease to exist on leaving play. Refrigerator Alarm, Unscrupuls of Victory. |
| `trade-condition` | implemented | condition | 1 | Condition { type:'cardTradeIs', target, trade } (and/or a `trade` field on CardSelector) to match/exclude by trade — 'all non-Rogue characters'. Trivial. Delicious Strawberry Flavored Death. |
